text: Cenomi Centers is chaired by Fawaz Al Hokair; its 2024 annual report's Major Shareholders List names FAS Real Estate Co. (28.0% at the end of 2024), Abdulmajid Al-Hokair (7.9%), Salman Al-Hokair (7.3%), Al Farida Al-Thaniah Co. (3.8%) and Fawaz Al-Hokair (3.2%).
short: Cenomi Centers is led by the Al Hokair family and FAS Real Estate.

source.name: Cenomi Centers: Annual Report 2024 (p. 90: Major Shareholders List)
source.note: Major Shareholders List (p. 90, year-end 2024; PDF reviewed via text extraction on 2026-10-04). Fawaz Al Hokair is chairman per the report ('Fawaz Alhokair, Chairman', p. 3).
